Arcana Domain.name: Veiled Spellwarden
Arcana Domain.text: When a creature you can see within 60 feet casts a spell, you can use your reaction to wrap it in mist. It makes a Wisdom save against your spell DC or the spell fails and its slot is lost. Once per short rest.

Arcana Domain.name: Sigil-Judge Magister
Arcana Domain.text: As an action, inscribe a binding sigil on a creature within 60 feet. For 1 minute, whenever it casts a spell, it takes 3d8 radiant or fire damage (your choice) and you regain a 1st-level spell slot. Once per long rest.

Arcana Domain.name: Wildweave Theurge
Arcana Domain.text: When you cast a cleric spell of 1st level or higher, roll a d6. On 4 or higher, you also cast a random wizard cantrip at the same target for free. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

Arcana Domain.name: Deepglyph Scholar
Arcana Domain.text: As a reaction when you or an ally within 30 feet fails a save against a spell, they reroll with advantage. On a success, the caster takes 4d8 force damage. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

Arcana Domain.name: Heartspell Archmage
Arcana Domain.text: Choose two wizard spells of 6th level or lower; they become cleric spells for you and are always prepared. Once per long rest you can cast one of them without expending a slot, and its damage or healing dice are maximized.

Arcana Domain.name: Starchart Magus
Arcana Domain.text: When you cast a spell that targets one creature, you can make it target one additional creature within 120 feet of the first, tracing a line of stars between them. Usable a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

Arcana Domain.name: Hollow-Rune Mystic
Arcana Domain.text: Once per long rest, cast any spell of 8th level or lower from any class list that you have seen cast, using a cleric slot. Targets have disadvantage on saves against it and forget it afterward.

Arcana Domain.name: Lost-Script Hierophant
Arcana Domain.text: Once per long rest, you can cast any spell from any class list of 8th level or lower that you have seen cast, using a cleric spell slot. Creatures affected cannot recall the spell afterward and have disadvantage on saves to resist it.

Arcana Domain.name: First-Word Archmage
Arcana Domain.text: Once per long rest, speak a fragment of the first Law to cast any two spells of 9th level or lower in one action without expending slots. Each target makes its save with disadvantage, and spell damage ignores resistance.

Astral Domain.name: Fogstar Seer
Astral Domain.text: When you enter your incorporeal astral form, you also become invisible until the start of your next turn and can move through creatures. While in that form, attacks against you have disadvantage. Usable twice per short rest.

Astral Domain.name: Haloed Starwarden
Astral Domain.text: As an action, call down a burning star within 120 feet. Creatures in a 20-foot radius make a Dexterity save, taking 4d10 radiant damage and being pulled 15 feet toward the center, or half damage on a success. Once per short rest.

Astral Domain.name: Shifting-Orbit Priest
Astral Domain.text: At the start of each of your turns for 1 minute, rotate gravity within 30 feet. Enemies there make a Strength save or fall 20 feet in a direction you choose, taking 2d6 bludgeoning damage and landing prone. Once per long rest.

Astral Domain.name: Sunken-Star Oracle
Astral Domain.text: As a bonus action, a creature within 60 feet makes a Strength save or is pulled 30 feet toward you, takes 5d8 force damage, and is restrained until the end of your next turn. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

Astral Domain.name: Coreflame Astrologer
Astral Domain.text: While in astral form, you shed bright light for 30 feet. Allies in it regain 2d8 hit points at the start of their turns and have advantage on death saves. Your astral form lasts 1 minute, twice per long rest.

Astral Domain.name: Horizon-Orbit Prelate
Astral Domain.text: As an action, up to six willing allies within 30 feet join your orbit for 1 minute. Each can teleport 30 feet as a bonus action, and ranged attacks against them have disadvantage. Once per long rest.

Astral Domain.name: Starless Ascetic
Astral Domain.text: As an action, collapse a point within 120 feet into a black star. Creatures within 30 feet make a Strength save or are pulled to the center, take 8d10 force damage and are restrained for 1 round. Once per long rest.

Astral Domain.name: Folded-Sky Exarch
Astral Domain.text: Once per long rest, as a reaction to taking damage, you fold into your astral form and the damage is negated. Until the end of your next turn you are untargetable, and the attacker makes a Wisdom save or forgets you exist for 1 minute.

Astral Domain.name: Firstlight Cosmarch
Astral Domain.text: Once per long rest, ignite a star within 300 feet for 1 minute. Enemies within 60 feet of it take 10d10 radiant damage at the start of their turns (Constitution save for half). Allies there regain 20 hit points instead.

Flame Domain.name: Smokeveil Firepriest
Flame Domain.text: When you wreathe a weapon in pale flame, its hits deal an extra 2d8 fire damage and the target cannot see the wielder until the start of its next turn. Lasts 1 minute, twice per short rest.

Flame Domain.name: Brimstone Psalmist
Flame Domain.text: As an action, set a creature within 60 feet ablaze with judgement. It makes a Wisdom save or burns for 1 minute, taking 4d8 fire damage at the start of each turn and losing fire resistance. Repeat the save each turn. Once per short rest.

Flame Domain.name: Wildflame Hierophant
Flame Domain.text: When you deal fire damage, roll a d4: 1 flames leap to another creature within 15 feet for half; 2 the target is blinded for 1 round; 3 you regain 2d8 hit points; 4 the damage is maximized.

Flame Domain.name: Deepfire Confessor
Flame Domain.text: Your fire burns underwater and in magical darkness, and ignores fire resistance. As a bonus action, a creature you hit with fire makes a Constitution save or is crushed by heat, taking 5d6 extra fire damage and being unable to take reactions.

Flame Domain.name: Hearthcore Pontiff
Flame Domain.text: Allies within 30 feet have resistance to cold and fire damage. Once per long rest, as an action, up to six allies deal an extra 2d8 fire damage on weapon hits and regain 10 hit points each turn for 1 minute.

Flame Domain.name: Sunroad Pyrarch
Flame Domain.text: As an action, release a flare in a 120-foot line, 10 feet wide. Creatures in it make a Dexterity save, taking 8d8 fire damage and being blinded for 1 round on a failure, or half damage on a success. Recharges on a short rest.

Flame Domain.name: Ashless Ember
Flame Domain.text: Your flames now burn without heat or light and cannot be sensed. Fire damage you deal ignores immunity, treating it as resistance. As a reaction when you take damage, wreathe yourself in void fire, dealing 6d8 fire damage to the attacker. Twice per long rest.

Flame Domain.name: Ember of Forgetting
Flame Domain.text: Once per long rest, burn a creature within 60 feet with the fire of erased memory. It takes 12d10 fire damage (Constitution save for half). On a failure it also forgets one spell or class feature of your choice until its next long rest.

Flame Domain.name: Primal Pyre Pontifex
Flame Domain.text: Once per long rest, you become the first fire for 1 minute. You are immune to fire, your weapon attacks deal an extra 4d10 fire damage, and as a bonus action you can heal an ally within 60 feet for 6d10 hit points.

Forge Domain.name: Misthammer Artisan
Forge Domain.text: As an action, forge a temporary weapon or shield from fog for 1 hour. The weapon gains +1 and deals an extra 2d6 force damage; the shield grants +1 AC. Its wielder is lightly obscured. Twice per long rest.

Forge Domain.name: Hellforge Smith
Forge Domain.text: When you finish a long rest, bind one weapon or armor with an infernal contract. A weapon deals an extra 2d8 fire damage; armor deals 2d8 fire damage to any creature that hits its wearer in melee. One item at a time.

Forge Domain.name: Chaos-Anvil Wright
Forge Domain.text: As a bonus action, reshape a weapon or armor you touch into another form of the same kind, granting +1 to attack rolls or AC until the end of the wielder's next turn. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier per short rest.

Forge Domain.name: Deepiron Founder
Forge Domain.text: While wearing heavy armor, you reduce bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage by an extra 2 per hit and cannot be moved against your will. As a reaction, impose disadvantage on an attack against an ally within 10 feet. Three times per long rest.

Forge Domain.name: Heartforge Hierarch
Forge Domain.text: Weapons and armor you craft heal themselves and their wearer. A creature wearing armor you made regains 1d10 hit points at the start of each turn while above 0 hit points. Once per long rest, you can fully restore a destroyed magic item.

Forge Domain.name: Starmetal Forgelord
Forge Domain.text: As an action, call down molten starmetal on a point within 120 feet. Creatures in a 20-foot radius make a Dexterity save, taking 6d10 fire damage or half on a success. The metal cools into a +2 weapon of your choice. Once per long rest.

Forge Domain.name: Hollow-Anvil Smith
Forge Domain.text: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, coat a weapon in void-forged edge for 1 minute. Its hits ignore resistance and immunity to its damage type and deal an extra 3d10 force damage. The target cannot regain hit points until your next turn.

Forge Domain.name: Forgotten-Furnace Lord
Forge Domain.text: Once per long rest, as an action, touch a magic item that is not an artifact and unmake it from memory. If held, the holder makes a Constitution save to resist, and on a failure also takes 10d10 force damage.

Forge Domain.name: Firstforge Pontifex
Forge Domain.text: Once per long rest, spend 1 minute at your anvil to forge a legendary magic item of your choice that lasts 7 days. Alternatively, as an action, grant up to six allies +2 AC and resistance to all damage for 1 minute.

Grave Domain.name: Fogbarrow Warden
Grave Domain.text: When an ally within 60 feet drops to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to wrap them in grave mist. They instead drop to 1 hit point and become invisible until the end of their next turn. Wisdom modifier uses per long rest.

Grave Domain.name: Soul-Ledger Keeper
Grave Domain.text: When a creature within 60 feet dies, record its soul. You can spend a recorded soul as a bonus action to grant an ally 4d8 temporary hit points or deal 4d8 necrotic damage to a creature you can see. Hold up to five souls.

Grave Domain.name: Restless-Grave Priest
Grave Domain.text: When you cast a spell that heals or deals necrotic damage, roll a d6. On an even number, the healing or damage is also applied in reverse to a creature of your choice within 30 feet. Wisdom modifier uses per long rest.

Grave Domain.name: Drowned-Tomb Confessor
Grave Domain.text: As an action, a creature within 60 feet with 100 hit points or fewer makes a Constitution save or takes 8d8 necrotic damage and is restrained for 1 minute, repeating the save each turn. Once per long rest.

Grave Domain.name: Lifeline Warden
Grave Domain.text: You sense the exact hit points of every creature within 120 feet. Allies there cannot be killed by massive damage, and once per long rest you can return an ally who died within 1 minute to life with half their hit points as a reaction.

Grave Domain.name: Far-Horizon Psychopomp
Grave Domain.text: When you hit a creature with a spell or attack, it makes a Constitution save or cannot regain hit points until your next turn, and dies outright if reduced below 50 hit points. Twice per long rest.

Grave Domain.name: Silent Barrow Prior
Grave Domain.text: When you hit a creature with a spell or attack, you can mark it as already dead. Until your next turn it cannot regain hit points, and if it drops below 50 hit points it dies outright. Constitution save negates. Twice per long rest.

Grave Domain.name: Keeper of Lost Graves
Grave Domain.text: Once per long rest, choose a creature that died within the last day, even with its body destroyed. It returns to life with full hit points, and enemies that killed it make a Wisdom save or forget it and cannot target it for 1 minute.

Grave Domain.name: First Grave Pontifex
Grave Domain.text: Once per long rest, as an action, declare a creature within 120 feet ended. If it has 300 hit points or fewer, it makes a Constitution save or dies. On a success it takes 15d10 necrotic damage and cannot be healed for 1 minute.

Gravecaller.name: Fogwalk Soulguide
Gravecaller.text: As an action, call a spirit from the mist within 60 feet. It answers three questions truthfully or fights for you for 1 minute as a spectral ally with 60 hit points that deals 2d10 necrotic damage on a hit. Once per short rest.

Gravecaller.name: Two-Gate Psychopomp
Gravecaller.text: When a creature within 60 feet dies, choose: send it to Heaven, granting allies within 30 feet 4d8 hit points, or to Hell, dealing 4d8 fire damage to enemies within 30 feet of its body. Wisdom modifier uses per long rest.

Gravecaller.name: Crossroads Gravecaller
Gravecaller.text: As an action, two creatures within 60 feet exchange hit point totals for 1 round, neither exceeding its maximum. An unwilling creature makes a Charisma save to resist. After 1 round, totals return minus any damage taken. Once per long rest.

Gravecaller.name: Deepwake Soulcaller
Gravecaller.text: As an action, summon drowned spirits in a 30-foot radius within 90 feet for 1 minute. Enemies starting their turn there make a Strength save or take 5d8 necrotic damage and are restrained until the start of their next turn. Once per long rest.

Gravecaller.name: Lifevein Mediator
Gravecaller.text: As a bonus action, move up to 50 hit points from one willing creature within 60 feet to another. As an action, you can instead drain 6d10 necrotic damage from a hostile creature (Constitution save for half) and give it to an ally.

Gravecaller.name: Starwake Soulguide
Gravecaller.text: As an action, summon five ancestral spirits within 120 feet for 1 minute. Each acts on your turn, has 80 hit points and AC 16, and grants one ally +1 AC and 3d8 radiant damage on weapon hits while adjacent. Once per long rest.

Gravecaller.name: Hollow-Gate Warden
Gravecaller.text: A creature you can see within 120 feet makes a Charisma save or its soul is pushed into the void for 1 minute. It is incapacitated and cannot be targeted or healed by its allies. It repeats the save each turn. Once per long rest.

Gravecaller.name: Caller of Lost Souls
Gravecaller.text: Once per long rest, call back a soul whose name has been forgotten. Restore a dead creature to life, or summon a spirit with the statistics of any dead creature of CR 20 or lower that you have seen, serving you for 1 hour.

Gravecaller.name: Primordial Psychopomp
Gravecaller.text: Once per long rest, open the first gate between life and death for 1 minute. Allies within 120 feet who die return at the start of their next turn with 100 hit points. Enemies who die cannot be resurrected.

Knowledge Domain.name: Mist-Lore Vicar
Knowledge Domain.text: As an action, read the surface thoughts and the true form of a creature within 60 feet, seeing through illusions and disguises on it. It makes a Wisdom save or you also learn one of its secrets. Uses equal to Wisdom modifier per long rest.

Knowledge Domain.name: Archivist of Verdicts
Knowledge Domain.text: As an action, a creature within 30 feet makes a Charisma save or cannot speak a deliberate lie for 1 hour. Each time it tries, it takes 4d8 psychic damage and you learn the truth it hid. Once per short rest.

Knowledge Domain.name: Shifting-Page Sage
Knowledge Domain.text: As a bonus action, gain proficiency and expertise in any skill or tool, and proficiency with any one weapon, for 10 minutes. Once per long rest, you also learn one spell of 5th level or lower from any list for 1 hour.

Knowledge Domain.name: Deep-Lore Confessor
Knowledge Domain.text: When you touch a creature, object or place, you can learn its full history from the last 100 years. A hostile creature makes a Wisdom save or takes 6d8 psychic damage and is stunned until the end of its next turn. Once per short rest.

Knowledge Domain.name: Heartlore Hierarch
Knowledge Domain.text: You know the hit points, resistances, immunities, vulnerabilities and saving throw bonuses of any creature you see. Once per round, when you or an ally attacks such a creature, the attack ignores one resistance you name.

Knowledge Domain.name: Starlore Prelate
Knowledge Domain.text: Once per long rest, consult the knowledge of distant worlds for 1 minute to cast commune, legend lore or contact other plane without a slot. You also learn one fact the DM considers crucial about your current goal.

Knowledge Domain.name: Silent-Page Prior
Knowledge Domain.text: As an action, a creature within 60 feet makes an Intelligence save or forgets how to cast spells or use one class feature for 1 minute, repeating the save each turn. On a success, it takes 8d8 psychic damage. Once per long rest.

Knowledge Domain.name: Forgotten-Page Keeper
Knowledge Domain.text: Once per long rest, you recall any knowledge ever lost or forgotten. You can ask the DM three questions about anything, past or present, and receive true answers, and you gain advantage on all checks and saves for 1 hour.

Knowledge Domain.name: First-Thought Pontifex
Knowledge Domain.text: Once per long rest, for 1 minute you know everything within 1 mile: every creature's location, thoughts and intentions. You cannot be surprised, attacks against you have disadvantage, and your allies gain advantage on attack rolls.

Life Domain.name: Mistmend Vicar
Life Domain.text: When you cast a healing spell, the target is also wreathed in fog until the end of its next turn, becoming heavily obscured to enemies. Healing spells you cast at range now restore an extra 2d8 hit points.

Life Domain.name: Halo of Mercy
Life Domain.text: When an ally within 60 feet drops to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to heal them for 4d8 plus your Wisdom modifier and end one condition affecting them. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

Life Domain.name: Wildbloom Hierophant
Life Domain.text: When you roll healing dice, you can reroll any of them and take the higher. Any excess healing beyond a creature's maximum becomes temporary hit points, up to 30. Healing spells you cast can also end one disease or poison.

Life Domain.name: Deepspring Confessor
Life Domain.text: As an action, create a 30-foot-radius spring of deep water for 1 minute. Allies starting their turn in it regain 4d8 hit points and end one condition. Enemies there have disadvantage on attacks against creatures in the spring. Once per long rest.

Life Domain.name: Lifeheart Hierarch
Life Domain.text: As an action, touch a creature to undo all damage it has taken in the past minute, restoring those hit points and ending any condition, curse or lost limb from that time. Usable twice per long rest.

Life Domain.name: Dawnroad Lifewarden
Life Domain.text: Your healing spells can target any creature you have met that is on the same plane, regardless of distance. Once per long rest, you cast mass heal without a slot, choosing targets across any distance on your plane.

Life Domain.name: Hollow-Hope Prior
Life Domain.text: Your healing works on creatures that cannot normally be healed and ignores effects that prevent healing. Once per long rest, as a reaction, an ally who would die instead drops to 1 hit point and is immune to all damage until your next turn.

Life Domain.name: Keeper of Unspent Life
Life Domain.text: Once per long rest, choose up to six allies within 120 feet. Their wounds are forgotten by the world: each regains all hit points, spent hit dice and spell slots of 5th level or lower, and ends all conditions.

Life Domain.name: Firstlife Pontifex
Life Domain.text: Once per long rest, breathe first life over a 120-foot radius. Allies within regain all hit points, and any ally who died within the past day returns to life with no penalty. For 1 minute, allies there cannot fall below 1 hit point.

Light Domain.name: Lanternfog Vicar
Light Domain.text: You shed bright light for 30 feet that reveals invisible creatures and illusions. As a reaction when a creature in your light attacks, impose disadvantage and deal 2d8 radiant damage to it. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

Light Domain.name: Dawn-Throne Herald
Light Domain.text: As an action, fire a 60-foot line of heavenly light. Creatures in it make a Dexterity save, taking 5d8 radiant damage and being blinded until the end of their next turn, or half damage on a success. Once per short rest.

Light Domain.name: Prismatic Hierophant
Light Domain.text: When you deal radiant damage, roll a d6 to split the light: 1-2 fire, 3-4 lightning, 5-6 radiant again, dealing an extra 2d8 of that type to the target and one other creature within 10 feet. Wisdom modifier uses per long rest.

Light Domain.name: Deeplight Confessor
Light Domain.text: Your light pierces magical darkness and works underwater. Creatures of darkness or the deep that start their turn in your bright light make a Constitution save or take 6d8 radiant damage and lose any resistances until your next turn.

Light Domain.name: Heartflame Hierarch
Light Domain.text: As an action, ignite an inner sun for 1 minute. You and allies within 30 feet gain resistance to necrotic damage and regain 2d8 hit points each turn, while enemies within 30 feet take 3d8 radiant damage each turn. Once per long rest.

Light Domain.name: Sunroad Prelate
Light Domain.text: Once per long rest, cast sunburst without a slot, centered anywhere within 1 mile you can see. Its damage dice are maximized against fiends and undead, and the area remains in bright sunlight for 1 hour.

Light Domain.name: Last-Light Prior
Light Domain.text: Your light shines in places of absolute void, antimagic and darkness. As an action, unleash a 60-foot cone of starkest light. Creatures make a Constitution save or take 10d8 radiant damage and are blinded for 1 minute. Half on success. Once per long rest.

Light Domain.name: Forgotten-Dawn Keeper
Light Domain.text: Once per long rest, you recall a dawn the world forgot. For 1 minute you become pure light: you are immune to radiant damage, have a flying speed of 120 feet, and your attacks and cantrips deal an extra 6d10 radiant damage.

Light Domain.name: Firstdawn Pontifex
Light Domain.text: Once per long rest, you call the first dawn over a 1-mile radius. Fiends and undead there make a Charisma save or are destroyed outright if they have 200 hit points or fewer, or take 20d10 radiant damage on a success.

Nature Domain.name: Mossfog Vicar
Nature Domain.text: As an action, fill a 30-foot radius within 60 feet with fog and grasping vines for 1 minute. Enemies inside are heavily obscured to others and make a Strength save each turn or are restrained. Allies inside move freely. Once per short rest.

Nature Domain.name: Bloom-and-Brand Druid-Priest
Nature Domain.text: Vines lash any creature that hits you or an ally within 10 feet of you in melee, dealing 2d8 piercing plus 2d8 fire damage as a reaction. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

Nature Domain.name: Wildgrowth Hierophant
Nature Domain.text: As an action, cause wild growth in a 40-foot radius for 1 minute. At the start of each turn, roll a d4: thorns, healing pollen, grasping roots, or a summoned beast of CR 5, each with an appropriate effect you choose. Once per long rest.

Nature Domain.name: Deeproot Confessor
Nature Domain.text: As an action, call kelp and deep roots in a 30-foot radius within 90 feet. Creatures there make a Strength save or take 6d8 bludgeoning damage, are restrained and begin to drown. They repeat the save each turn. Once per long rest.

Nature Domain.name: Greenheart Hierarch
Nature Domain.text: Plants and beasts within 1 mile tell you all they know. As a bonus action, you can command beasts and plant creatures within 120 feet with CR 15 or lower, which make a Wisdom save or obey you for 1 minute.

Nature Domain.name: Starbloom Prelate
Nature Domain.text: Once per long rest, grow a grove of starflowers in a 60-foot radius for 1 hour. Allies resting there gain the benefits of a short rest in 10 minutes, and enemies entering it take 6d8 radiant damage (Constitution save for half).

Nature Domain.name: Barren-Field Prior
Nature Domain.text: As an action, drain all life from a 60-foot radius. Enemies there make a Constitution save, taking 10d8 necrotic damage and gaining one level of exhaustion on a failure, or half damage on a success. Plants there die. Once per long rest.

Nature Domain.name: Forgotten-Glade Keeper
Nature Domain.text: Once per long rest, raise a forest the world forgets in a 300-foot radius for 1 day. Allies within it cannot be found by any divination or senses. Enemies entering make a Wisdom save or become lost, unable to leave for 1 hour.

Nature Domain.name: First-Garden Pontifex
Nature Domain.text: Once per long rest, you plant the first seed. For 1 minute, all terrain within 1 mile obeys you: as a bonus action you can restrain any number of creatures you see (Strength save), or heal all allies you see for 10d10 hit points.

Order Domain.name: Fogmarshal Vicar
Order Domain.text: When you cast a spell on an ally, you can whisper a command through the mist. A creature within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save or must obey a one-word command, unaware who gave it. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

Order Domain.name: Magistrate of Two Courts
Order Domain.text: As an action, pronounce a sentence on a creature within 60 feet. It makes a Charisma save or, for 1 minute, takes 4d8 radiant damage each time it attacks anyone other than you. It repeats the save each turn. Once per short rest.

Order Domain.name: Law-in-Chaos Hierophant
Order Domain.text: As an action, create a 30-foot-radius zone of order for 1 minute. Inside, no die can roll below 10 for allies, and random magical effects resolve as you choose. Enemies cannot teleport or change shape inside it. Once per long rest.

Order Domain.name: Deep-Law Confessor
Order Domain.text: When an ally hits a creature you have sentenced, that creature makes a Strength save or is crushed under the law, taking 5d8 force damage and falling prone with its speed reduced to 0 until your next turn.

Order Domain.name: Heartlaw Hierarch
Order Domain.text: Once per long rest, declare a law for a 120-foot radius lasting 1 hour, such as no flight or no teleportation. Creatures that break it take 10d8 force damage (Charisma save for half) and their action fails.

Order Domain.name: Horizon Lawgiver
Order Domain.text: Your Voice of Authority now affects up to three allies at once, and each can make one weapon attack or cast a cantrip as a reaction. Once per long rest you can cast command at 9th level without a slot.

Order Domain.name: Silent Edict Prior
Order Domain.text: As an action, a creature within 60 feet makes a Charisma save or is forbidden to act. It is incapacitated and cannot use reactions for 1 minute, repeating the save each turn. On a success it is slowed for 1 round. Once per long rest.

Order Domain.name: Keeper of Lost Laws
Order Domain.text: Once per long rest, invoke a law the world forgot. For 1 minute, choose one game rule such as healing, flight or spellcasting; enemies within 300 feet cannot benefit from it, with no save allowed for creatures under 300 hit points.

Order Domain.name: First-Law Pontifex
Order Domain.text: Once per long rest, speak a decree in the first Law. All creatures within 300 feet make a Charisma save or obey it for 1 minute, as long as it does not order self-destruction. Allies gain advantage on all rolls while obeying.

Peace Domain.name: Fogbond Vicar
Peace Domain.text: Creatures linked by your Emboldening Bond can see each other through fog and illusion and can swap places as a bonus action once per turn while within 60 feet of each other. Bonded creatures gain +1 AC while adjacent.

Peace Domain.name: Concord Arbiter
Peace Domain.text: When a bonded creature takes damage, you can split it evenly among all willing bonded creatures within 60 feet. Each bonded creature also gains 2d8 temporary hit points whenever an ally in the bond drops a foe.

Peace Domain.name: Calm-in-Storm Hierophant
Peace Domain.text: Bonded creatures are immune to the charmed and frightened conditions and cannot have their positions changed against their will. When any bonded creature rolls a 1 on a d20, it can reroll it. Lasts as long as the bond.

Peace Domain.name: Deep-Still Confessor
Peace Domain.text: As an action, a creature within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save or is pacified for 1 minute, unable to attack or cast harmful spells. Damage ends it. On a success it takes 6d8 psychic damage. Uses equal to Wisdom modifier per long rest.

Peace Domain.name: Heartbond Hierarch
Peace Domain.text: Bonded creatures share a single pool of hit points equal to the sum of their own while bonded. Once per long rest, as an action, all bonded creatures regain hit points equal to half that shared maximum.

Peace Domain.name: Far-Concord Prelate
Peace Domain.text: Your bond works across any distance on the same plane. Bonded creatures can cast spells on each other as if adjacent and, once per long rest each, teleport to the side of another bonded creature as a bonus action.

Peace Domain.name: Silent-Truce Prior
Peace Domain.text: Once per long rest, as an action, declare peace in a 120-foot radius for 1 minute. Every creature there makes a Charisma save or cannot deal damage. Any creature that deals damage in the area ends the effect for itself only.

Peace Domain.name: Keeper of Forgotten Feuds
Peace Domain.text: Once per long rest, a group of up to ten creatures within 300 feet makes a Wisdom save or forgets their hostility toward you and your allies for 24 hours. On a success, they are stunned until the end of their next turn.

Peace Domain.name: First-Peace Pontifex
Peace Domain.text: Once per long rest, restore the peace before the first war in a 1-mile radius for 1 hour. No creature can deal damage there unless it succeeds on a Charisma save each turn. Allies regain 20 hit points each turn.

Rune Priest.name: Mistglyph Scribe
Rune Priest.text: As a bonus action, inscribe an invisible rune within 30 feet. When an enemy comes within 10 feet of it, it flares for 3d8 force damage and blinds the creature until its next turn. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier per short rest.

Rune Priest.name: Sigil-Oath Inscriber
Rune Priest.text: Inscribe a rune of Heaven or Hell on an ally. A Heaven rune grants 3d8 temporary hit points at the start of each turn; a Hell rune adds 3d8 fire damage to their weapon hits. Lasts 1 minute, twice per long rest.

Rune Priest.name: Shifting-Script Priest
Rune Priest.text: As a bonus action, rewrite any rune you placed within 60 feet into a different rune you know, changing its effect immediately. When a rune triggers, roll a d6; on a 6 it does not vanish and can trigger again.

Rune Priest.name: Deepcarved Lector
Rune Priest.text: Runes you inscribe on allies last until your next long rest. Each ally can carry one, granting resistance to one damage type of your choice and regaining 5 hit points per turn while above 0 hit points.

Rune Priest.name: Heartscript Hierarch
Rune Priest.text: Runes you inscribe on allies grow into their bodies and last until your next long rest. Each ally can carry one rune granting resistance to one damage type of your choice and regeneration of 5 hit points per turn while above 0 hit points.

Rune Priest.name: Starscript Prelate
Rune Priest.text: As an action, link up to seven of your runes into a constellation. Allies standing on any linked rune can teleport to any other as a bonus action, and enemies on them take 6d8 radiant damage (Dexterity save for half). Once per long rest.

Rune Priest.name: Blank-Page Prior
Rune Priest.text: As an action, inscribe a rune of nothing on a creature within 60 feet. It makes a Charisma save or loses all magical effects on it and cannot benefit from magic items for 1 minute, repeating the save each turn. Once per long rest.

Rune Priest.name: Keeper of Lost Script
Rune Priest.text: Once per long rest, carve a glyph the world forgot over a 120-foot radius for 1 minute. You choose one effect for allies, such as immunity to a condition, and one for enemies, such as 8d10 force damage per turn (Constitution save for half).

Rune Priest.name: First-Script Pontifex
Rune Priest.text: Once per long rest, write a word of the first Law on reality itself. For 1 hour, the area within 1 mile becomes your sacred text: you can trigger any rune you know anywhere within it as a bonus action, without spending uses.

Tempest Domain.name: Fogstorm Vicar
Tempest Domain.text: When you deal lightning or thunder damage, you can surround the target with stormy fog. It makes a Constitution save or is deafened and blinded until the end of its next turn. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

Tempest Domain.name: Wrath-Storm Herald
Tempest Domain.text: As an action, call down lightning on up to three creatures within 120 feet. Each makes a Dexterity save, taking 5d10 lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. Fiends and undead have disadvantage on the save. Once per short rest.

Tempest Domain.name: Wildgale Hierophant
Tempest Domain.text: As an action, create a 40-foot-radius storm within 120 feet for 1 minute. At the start of each of your turns roll a d4 for lightning strike, gale push, hail, or thunderclap, each dealing 4d8 damage of its type. Once per long rest.

Tempest Domain.name: Deepsea Stormcaller
Tempest Domain.text: As an action, create a 30-foot whirlpool within 90 feet. Creatures in it make a Strength save or are pulled 15 feet toward the center, take 6d8 bludgeoning damage and are restrained. Lasts 1 minute, once per long rest.

Tempest Domain.name: Stormheart Hierarch
Tempest Domain.text: You are always at the calm center of storms: you are immune to lightning and thunder damage. When you deal lightning or thunder damage, you can reduce the target's speed to 0 and prevent it from taking reactions until your next turn.

Tempest Domain.name: Skyroad Stormlord
Tempest Domain.text: Once per long rest, summon a storm over a 1-mile radius for 1 hour. As a bonus action each turn, call a lightning bolt on any creature you see within it, dealing 8d10 lightning damage (Dexterity save for half).

Tempest Domain.name: Silent-Thunder Prior
Tempest Domain.text: As an action, release a silent shockwave in a 60-foot radius. Creatures make a Constitution save or take 10d8 thunder damage and are deafened and silenced for 1 minute. Half damage on a success. Once per long rest.

Tempest Domain.name: Forgotten-Storm Keeper
Tempest Domain.text: Once per long rest, call the storm that ended a forgotten world for 1 minute. Lightning you deal ignores immunity, and once per turn you can strike every enemy within 120 feet for 6d10 lightning damage (Dexterity save for half).

Tempest Domain.name: Firststorm Pontifex
Tempest Domain.text: Once per long rest, become the first storm for 1 minute. You gain a flying speed of 120 feet and immunity to all damage from weather. Each turn, deal 10d10 lightning or thunder damage to up to three creatures (Dexterity save for half).

Trickery Domain.name: Mistmask Vicar
Trickery Domain.text: Your Invoke Duplicity now creates two illusory duplicates, and you can teleport to swap places with either as a bonus action. Attacks against you have disadvantage while a duplicate is within 5 feet of you.

Trickery Domain.name: Forked-Tongue Arbiter
Trickery Domain.text: As an action, offer a creature within 30 feet a false deal. It makes a Wisdom save or believes you are its ally for 1 minute, taking 4d8 psychic damage when it learns otherwise. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

Trickery Domain.name: Trickster of Upheaval
Trickery Domain.text: As an action, swap the positions of up to four creatures within 60 feet. Unwilling creatures make a Wisdom save to resist. Swapped enemies are confused and cannot take reactions until the end of their next turn. Once per short rest.

Trickery Domain.name: Deepmask Confessor
Trickery Domain.text: As an action, project an illusion of an irresistible lure within 120 feet. Creatures that see it make a Wisdom save or are charmed and must move toward it for 1 minute, taking 4d8 psychic damage on arrival. Once per long rest.

Trickery Domain.name: Heartmask Hierarch
Trickery Domain.text: You can transform into any creature you have seen for up to 8 hours, gaining its appearance, voice and senses. Spells and abilities cannot reveal your true form unless the caster succeeds on a Wisdom save against your DC.

Trickery Domain.name: Far-Mirror Prelate
Trickery Domain.text: Your duplicates can now be anywhere on the same plane, and you can see, hear and cast spells through them. Once per long rest, you can swap places with any duplicate or with any creature you have touched within the last day.

Trickery Domain.name: Nowhere Prior
Trickery Domain.text: As a bonus action, you remove yourself from all perception for 1 minute. You cannot be seen, heard, sensed or detected by any magic, and your first attack each turn deals an extra 6d8 psychic damage. Twice per long rest.

Trickery Domain.name: Keeper of Lost Lies
Trickery Domain.text: Once per long rest, rewrite the memories of up to ten creatures within 300 feet regarding the last hour. Each makes a Wisdom save or believes whatever version of events you choose, as though it truly happened.

Trickery Domain.name: First-Lie Pontifex
Trickery Domain.text: Once per long rest, tell a lie to the world itself. For 1 minute, one fact you speak becomes real, such as an enemy being your ally or a wall being open, with any creature affected making a Charisma save to resist.

Twilight Domain.name: Duskfog Vicar
Twilight Domain.text: Your Twilight Sanctuary also fills with protective mist. Allies inside are lightly obscured to enemies outside and gain advantage on saves against being frightened or charmed. When an ally ends its turn inside, it can teleport 15 feet.

Twilight Domain.name: Vesper Arbiter
Twilight Domain.text: When an enemy enters your Twilight Sanctuary, it makes a Wisdom save or takes 4d8 radiant damage and is frightened of you until the end of its next turn. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

Twilight Domain.name: Shifting-Dusk Hierophant
Twilight Domain.text: At the start of each of your turns while Twilight Sanctuary is active, roll a d4 to grant allies within it 2d8 temporary hit points, advantage on attacks, 10 feet of extra speed, or the end of one condition.

Twilight Domain.name: Deepnight Confessor
Twilight Domain.text: Your darkvision pierces magical darkness to 300 feet. Allies within 60 feet share it. As a reaction when an ally within 60 feet is frightened or falls to 0 hit points, they instead regain 5d8 hit points. Twice per long rest.

Twilight Domain.name: Heartdusk Hierarch
Twilight Domain.text: Your Twilight Sanctuary now has a 60-foot radius. Allies inside it regain 2d8 hit points at the start of each turn and gain resistance to necrotic and psychic damage while inside.

Twilight Domain.name: Starlit Vigilant
Twilight Domain.text: Once per long rest, turn the sky above a 1-mile radius to starry night for 1 hour. Allies there have truesight to 60 feet and advantage on initiative. Enemies there have disadvantage on saves against your spells.

Twilight Domain.name: Darkless Prior
Twilight Domain.text: Allies within your Twilight Sanctuary cannot be reduced below 1 hit point by necrotic or psychic damage. Once per long rest, as an action, all allies within 60 feet become immune to fear, despair and death effects for 1 minute.

Twilight Domain.name: Keeper of Lost Dusks
Twilight Domain.text: Once per long rest, bring down a night the world forgot over a 300-foot radius for 1 minute. Enemies inside make a Wisdom save or are blinded and frightened. Allies are invisible to enemies inside and regain 4d10 hit points each turn.

Twilight Domain.name: First-Dusk Pontifex
Twilight Domain.text: Once per long rest, summon the first night for 1 hour. Allies within 1 mile cannot drop below 1 hit point, and once per round as a bonus action you can heal one of them for 10d10 hit points.

War Domain.name: Fogline Crusader
War Domain.text: When you use your War Priest feature, your bonus attack can strike from the mist at a creature within 30 feet, teleporting you adjacent to it. On a hit, it deals an extra 2d8 force damage. Wisdom modifier uses per short rest.

War Domain.name: Banner-Throne Templar
War Domain.text: As a bonus action, let out a warcry. Allies within 60 feet gain +1d6 to attack rolls and 3d8 temporary hit points for 1 minute. Enemies within 60 feet make a Wisdom save or are frightened for 1 round. Once per short rest.

War Domain.name: Chaos-Front Warpriest
War Domain.text: When you or an ally within 30 feet misses an attack, roll a d6. On 4 or higher, the miss becomes a hit and deals an extra 3d8 damage. Usable a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

War Domain.name: Deepwar Confessor
War Domain.text: You cannot be knocked prone, pushed, grappled or restrained against your will. When you hit a creature with a weapon, you can push it 15 feet and deal an extra 4d8 force damage. Three times per short rest.

War Domain.name: Heartwar Hierarch
War Domain.text: Your weapon attacks deal an extra 3d8 radiant damage. As a bonus action, you can grant up to four allies within 30 feet an extra attack when they take the Attack action until the end of their next turn. Once per long rest.

War Domain.name: Horizon Warlord
War Domain.text: Once per long rest, summon a host of spectral warriors for 1 minute. Ten soldiers appear within 120 feet, each with 60 hit points and AC 18, dealing 3d10 radiant damage on hits. They act on your initiative and obey your commands.

War Domain.name: Silent-Battle Prior
War Domain.text: Once per turn when you hit with a weapon, the target makes a Constitution save or takes an extra 8d8 force damage and cannot regain hit points until your next turn. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

War Domain.name: Keeper of Lost Wars
War Domain.text: Once per long rest, call the warriors of a forgotten war for 1 minute. You and allies within 120 feet gain one extra attack per Attack action and +1 AC, and enemies must succeed on a Wisdom save or be frightened.

War Domain.name: First-War Pontifex
War Domain.text: Once per long rest, become the avatar of the first war for 1 minute. You make four attacks per Attack action, each dealing an extra 6d10 radiant damage, and you are immune to the frightened, stunned and paralyzed conditions.

Circle of Dreams.name: Fogdream Warden
Circle of Dreams.text: As an action, open a dream path to a point within 300 feet; you and up to five willing creatures travel it instantly. Enemies within 10 feet of the exit make a Wisdom save or fall asleep for 1 round. Twice per long rest.

Circle of Dreams.name: Lily-Dream Keeper
Circle of Dreams.text: Your Balm of the Summer Court now restores an extra 2d8 hit points per die and grants the target resistance to fire damage until the start of your next turn. A creature healed this way also ends the frightened condition.

Circle of Dreams.name: Waking-Dream Shaper
Circle of Dreams.text: As an action, a creature within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save or is trapped in a changing dream for 1 minute. Each turn roll a d4: it attacks an ally, falls prone, loses its action, or takes 4d8 psychic damage. Once per long rest.

Circle of Dreams.name: Deep-Slumber Elder
Circle of Dreams.text: As an action, creatures in a 30-foot radius within 120 feet make a Wisdom save or fall unconscious for 1 minute, waking only on 20 or more damage. Creatures immune to sleep take 6d8 psychic damage instead. Once per long rest.

Circle of Dreams.name: Dreamheart Archdruid
Circle of Dreams.text: Allies who finish a short rest within your Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow regain all hit points and one spent spell slot of 5th level or lower. Once per long rest, a short rest within it takes only 10 minutes.

Circle of Dreams.name: Starsleep Sower
Circle of Dreams.text: Once per long rest, you and up to eight creatures enter a shared dream for 1 hour that can carry you to any location on any plane you have heard described. You arrive refreshed, as if you had taken a short rest.

Circle of Dreams.name: Dreamless Hermit
Circle of Dreams.text: Once per long rest, pull up to ten creatures within 300 feet into a forgotten dream for 1 minute. Enemies make a Wisdom save or are incapacitated, while allies there regain 4d10 hit points each turn.

Circle of Dreams.name: Forgotten-Dream Seed
Circle of Dreams.text: Once per long rest, pull up to ten creatures within 300 feet into a forgotten dream for 1 minute. Enemies make a Wisdom save or are incapacitated while allies act normally and regain 4d10 hit points each turn inside the dream.

Circle of Dreams.name: First-Dreamer Ancient
Circle of Dreams.text: Once per long rest, you dream the world as it first was. For 1 minute, you can reshape terrain within 1 mile as a bonus action, and any creature you choose makes a Wisdom save or falls into endless sleep until you release it.

Circle of Rot.name: Fogmould Warden
Circle of Rot.text: As an action, release a 20-foot-radius cloud of spore-laden fog within 60 feet for 1 minute. Enemies inside are lightly obscured to others and take 2d8 necrotic damage at the start of each of their turns. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

Circle of Rot.name: Ashrot Keeper
Circle of Rot.text: Your withering touch carries hellish decay. A creature hit by it makes a Constitution save or loses fire and necrotic resistance and takes 4d8 extra necrotic damage, plus 2d8 at the start of each turn for 1 minute. It repeats the save each turn.

Circle of Rot.name: Wildrot Shaper
Circle of Rot.text: When a creature dies within 30 feet of you, its body bursts with spores. Each enemy within 15 feet of it makes a Constitution save or takes 4d8 poison damage and is poisoned until the end of its next turn. No uses limit.

Circle of Rot.name: Drownrot Elder
Circle of Rot.text: As an action, rot the ground in a 30-foot radius within 90 feet into sucking silt for 1 minute. Enemies inside have their speed halved and make a Constitution save each turn or take 5d8 necrotic damage. Once per long rest.

Circle of Rot.name: Rotheart Archdruid
Circle of Rot.text: Whenever an enemy within 60 feet takes necrotic damage from you, you or an ally within 30 feet regains hit points equal to half of that damage. You are immune to disease, poison damage and the poisoned condition.

Circle of Rot.name: Starmould Sower
Circle of Rot.text: Once per long rest, send spores across a 1-mile radius. For 1 hour, enemies there take 4d8 necrotic damage each round and cannot regain hit points; a Constitution save at the start of each turn halves the damage.

Circle of Rot.name: Barren-Rot Hermit
Circle of Rot.text: As an action, touch a creature: it makes a Constitution save or takes 12d8 necrotic damage and its maximum hit points are reduced by the same amount until a long rest. Half damage and no reduction on a success. Twice per long rest.

Circle of Rot.name: Forgotten-Rot Seed
Circle of Rot.text: Once per long rest, a creature within 120 feet makes a Constitution save or rots away from the world's memory, taking 12d10 necrotic damage. If this reduces it to 0 hit points, it cannot be raised and no one remembers it.

Circle of Rot.name: First-Rot Ancient
Circle of Rot.text: Once per long rest, become the first decay for 1 minute. All nonmagical objects and plant life within 60 feet rot away, and enemies within that radius take 10d10 necrotic damage at the start of their turns (Constitution save for half).

Circle of Spores.name: Fogspore Warden
Circle of Spores.text: Your Halo of Spores now has a range of 30 feet and deals 2d8 extra necrotic damage. Creatures damaged by it make a Wisdom save or cannot see beyond 10 feet through the fog of spores until the end of their next turn.

Circle of Spores.name: Brimspore Keeper
Circle of Spores.text: While Symbiotic Entity is active, enemies that hit you in melee take 3d8 fire and 3d8 necrotic damage. When it ends, it bursts in a 20-foot radius dealing 4d8 necrotic damage (Constitution save for half).

Circle of Spores.name: Chaosbloom Shaper
Circle of Spores.text: Creatures you raise as zombies with Fungal Infestation each gain a random mutation on a d4: extra 10 feet of speed, an extra attack, 30 temporary hit points, or poison breath for 4d8 damage. You can raise up to four zombies at once.

Circle of Spores.name: Drownspore Elder
Circle of Spores.text: As an action, spread mycelium in a 30-foot radius within 90 feet. Enemies there make a Strength save or are restrained by fungal threads for 1 minute, taking 4d8 necrotic damage each turn. They repeat the save each turn. Once per long rest.

Circle of Spores.name: Ringspore Archdruid
Circle of Spores.text: You are linked to all plants and fungi within 1 mile. You can sense all creatures touching the ground within it, and once per long rest you can teleport yourself and up to five allies to any fungus or plant in that range.

Circle of Spores.name: Starspore Sower
Circle of Spores.text: Once per long rest, release spores into the sky that settle in a 300-foot radius for 1 hour. Enemies there take 4d10 necrotic damage at the start of their turns (Constitution save for half), and slain enemies rise as your zombies.

Circle of Spores.name: Barren-Spore Hermit
Circle of Spores.text: As an action, a creature within 60 feet makes a Constitution save or spores burst from within it for 10d8 necrotic damage, plus 5d8 to each creature within 10 feet of it. Half damage on a success. Once per long rest.

Circle of Spores.name: Forgotten-Spore Seed
Circle of Spores.text: Once per long rest, fill a 120-foot radius with spores the world has forgotten for 1 minute. Enemies there make a Wisdom save or are charmed by the colony and fight for you, repeating the save each turn.

Circle of Spores.name: First-Spore Ancient
Circle of Spores.text: Once per long rest, you become the primordial colony for 1 minute. You split into up to five spore bodies within 120 feet, each with your hit points divided equally, that act on your turn and can each cast cantrips.

Circle of Stars.name: Fogstar Warden
Circle of Stars.text: While in your Starry Form, you can become invisible until the end of your turn as a bonus action. Your constellation effects also gain +1d8 to their healing or damage. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

Circle of Stars.name: Haloed Astrologer
Circle of Stars.text: Gain two new Starry Form options. The Seraph: allies within 30 feet regain 2d8 hit points when you cast a spell. The Brand: enemies you damage take 2d8 fire damage at the start of their next turn.

Circle of Stars.name: Wild-Orbit Shaper
Circle of Stars.text: When you enter Starry Form, roll a d6 to change your constellation randomly. You gain its effect and one other of your choice simultaneously for 1 minute. You can use Starry Form twice more per long rest.

Circle of Stars.name: Deep-Sky Elder
Circle of Stars.text: While in Starry Form, you see in magical darkness to 120 feet. As an action, a creature within 120 feet makes a Constitution save or is crushed by starlight weight, taking 6d8 radiant damage and being restrained for 1 round.

Circle of Stars.name: Heartstar Archdruid
Circle of Stars.text: Your Starry Form now lasts 1 hour and you can switch constellations at the start of each turn. While in Starry Form, you regain 10 hit points at the start of each of your turns.

Circle of Stars.name: Horizon Starseer
Circle of Stars.text: Once per long rest, open a gate of stars for 1 minute that lets you and up to ten allies travel to any point within 1 mile. Enemies standing where you arrive take 8d10 radiant damage (Dexterity save for half).

Circle of Stars.name: Dead-Star Hermit
Circle of Stars.text: As an action, extinguish the stars in a 60-foot radius. Enemies there make a Constitution save or take 10d8 cold damage and are blinded for 1 minute. Half damage on a success. Once per long rest.

Circle of Stars.name: Forgotten-Star Seed
Circle of Stars.text: Once per long rest, call a constellation erased from the sky. For 1 minute, choose all three Starry Form effects at once, and their dice are maximized against any creature that fails a Wisdom save at the start of your turn.

Circle of Stars.name: First-Star Ancient
Circle of Stars.text: Once per long rest, become the first star for 1 minute. You emit bright light for 300 feet: enemies in it take 10d10 radiant damage at the start of their turns (Constitution save for half), and allies regain 10d10 hit points.

Circle of Wildfire.name: Fogfire Warden
Circle of Wildfire.text: Your Wildfire Spirit can turn into smoke as a bonus action, becoming heavily obscured and able to move through creatures. When it flame-blasts, the area fills with smoke that blinds enemies who fail a Constitution save until their next turn.

Circle of Wildfire.name: Ember-Lily Keeper
Circle of Wildfire.text: When your fire spells deal damage, an ally within 30 feet of the target regains hit points equal to half the damage. Your Wildfire Spirit now heals 3d8 hit points to allies in its teleport area.

Circle of Wildfire.name: Wildfire Shaper
Circle of Wildfire.text: When you deal fire damage, roll a d6. On 5 or 6, fire spreads to every enemy within 10 feet of the target, dealing 3d8 fire damage. Your Wildfire Spirit's attacks can also trigger this. No use limit.

Circle of Wildfire.name: Deepflame Elder
Circle of Wildfire.text: Your fire burns underwater and ignores fire resistance. As an action, ignite the ground in a 30-foot radius within 90 feet for 1 minute. Enemies there take 6d8 fire damage each turn (Dexterity save for half). Once per long rest.

Circle of Wildfire.name: Heartfire Archdruid
Circle of Wildfire.text: Once per long rest, as a reaction when you or an ally within 60 feet drops to 0 hit points, they burst into healing fire, regaining hit points equal to half their maximum. Each enemy within 10 feet takes 6d8 fire damage.

Circle of Wildfire.name: Starfire Sower
Circle of Wildfire.text: Once per long rest, call a burning meteor that strikes a point within 1 mile. Creatures in a 40-foot radius make a Dexterity save, taking 10d10 fire damage or half on a success. Plants grow back lush there within a day.

Circle of Wildfire.name: Coldember Hermit
Circle of Wildfire.text: Your flames can burn without air, fuel or light. Fire damage you deal ignores immunity, treating it as resistance. As an action, release a 60-foot cone of void fire dealing 10d8 fire damage (Dexterity save for half). Once per long rest.

Circle of Wildfire.name: Forgotten-Fire Seed
Circle of Wildfire.text: Once per long rest, burn a 300-foot radius with forgotten fire for 1 minute. Enemies there take 8d10 fire damage each turn (Constitution save for half). Allies there regain 4d10 hit points each turn instead of being harmed.

Circle of Wildfire.name: First-Fire Ancient
Circle of Wildfire.text: Once per long rest, become the first wildfire for 1 minute. You are immune to fire, your Wildfire Spirit grows to Huge size with 300 hit points, and its attacks deal 6d10 fire damage.

Circle of the Eclipse.name: Fogshadow Warden
Circle of the Eclipse.text: When you switch stances, you can become lightly obscured in shifting fog until your next turn. In the light stance allies within 10 feet gain this too; in the dark stance enemies within 10 feet are blinded on a failed Wisdom save.

Circle of the Eclipse.name: Halo-and-Ash Keeper
Circle of the Eclipse.text: Your light stance now grants allies within 30 feet 2d8 hit points each time you change forms. Your dark stance adds 3d8 fire damage to your Wild Shape attacks and inflicts the frightened condition on a critical hit.

Circle of the Eclipse.name: Eclipse Shaper
Circle of the Eclipse.text: At the start of each turn while in Wild Shape, you can change stance for free. When you do, deal 3d8 radiant or necrotic damage to one enemy within 30 feet of you, matching your new stance.

Circle of the Eclipse.name: Deep-Eclipse Elder
Circle of the Eclipse.text: In the dark stance, you gain blindsight to 60 feet and creatures you hit make a Strength save or are pulled under, restrained and blinded until the end of their next turn. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier per short rest.

Circle of the Eclipse.name: Heart-Eclipse Archdruid
Circle of the Eclipse.text: Once per long rest, merge both stances for 1 minute. You gain the benefits of both, regain 10 hit points each turn, and your Wild Shape attacks deal an extra 3d8 radiant and 3d8 necrotic damage.

Circle of the Eclipse.name: Total-Eclipse Sower
Circle of the Eclipse.text: Once per long rest, align sun and moon over a 1-mile radius for 1 hour. Allies there choose light or dark stance benefits individually, and enemies there have disadvantage on saves against your spells.

Circle of the Eclipse.name: Black-Sun Hermit
Circle of the Eclipse.text: As an action, become a black sun for 1 minute. Enemies within 30 feet take 6d8 necrotic damage at the start of their turns (Constitution save for half) and cannot regain hit points. Once per long rest.

Circle of the Eclipse.name: Forgotten-Eclipse Seed
Circle of the Eclipse.text: Once per long rest, cast a forgotten eclipse across 300 feet for 1 minute. Enemies there make a Wisdom save or forget whether it is day or night and cannot take reactions. Allies there are invisible in dim light.

Circle of the Eclipse.name: First-Eclipse Ancient
Circle of the Eclipse.text: Once per long rest, split yourself into light and dark aspects for 1 minute. Each is a copy with half your hit points that acts on your turn, and either can deal 10d10 radiant or necrotic damage as an action (Dexterity save for half).

Circle of the Land.name: Mistland Warden
Circle of the Land.text: As a bonus action, the ground within 30 feet of you becomes your chosen terrain for 1 minute, shrouded in fog. Allies there are lightly obscured and ignore difficult terrain. Enemies treat it as difficult terrain. Once per short rest.

Circle of the Land.name: Ashfield Keeper
Circle of the Land.text: Choose a heavenly garden or a hellish wasteland when you finish a long rest. Garden: allies within 30 feet regain 2d8 hit points at the start of their turns for 1 minute. Wasteland: enemies take 3d8 fire damage instead. Twice per long rest.

Circle of the Land.name: Wildterrain Shaper
Circle of the Land.text: As an action, reshape the land in a 60-foot radius within 120 feet for 1 minute. Each round, choose new terrain features such as walls, chasms or pillars. Creatures caught make a Dexterity save or take 4d8 damage. Once per long rest.

Circle of the Land.name: Deepland Elder
Circle of the Land.text: While touching the ground, you cannot be moved against your will and gain 4d8 temporary hit points at the start of each turn. As an action, crack the earth in a 30-foot line; creatures fall in, taking 6d8 bludgeoning damage (Dexterity save for half).

Circle of the Land.name: Landheart Archdruid
Circle of the Land.text: You are one with your chosen terrain. While standing on it, you regain 10 hit points at the start of your turns and can cast one druid spell of 5th level or lower without a slot once per long rest.

Circle of the Land.name: Many-Lands Sower
Circle of the Land.text: Your Circle Spells now include all terrains' spells, always prepared. Once per long rest, you can transport yourself and up to eight allies to any terrain you have visited on the same plane.

Circle of the Land.name: Barrenland Hermit
Circle of the Land.text: As an action, turn a 60-foot radius into barren void-touched land for 1 minute. Enemies there cannot regain hit points and take 6d8 cold damage each turn (Constitution save for half). Once per long rest.

Circle of the Land.name: Forgotten-Land Seed
Circle of the Land.text: Once per long rest, raise a forgotten land in a 1-mile radius for 1 day. Allies there cannot be found by divination or tracked. Enemies entering make a Wisdom save or become lost and return to where they started.

Circle of the Land.name: First-Land Ancient
Circle of the Land.text: Once per long rest, raise the first land in a 1-mile radius for 1 hour. You can reshape it as a bonus action each turn, and creatures you choose make a Strength save or are swallowed, taking 10d10 bludgeoning damage and restrained.

Circle of the Moon.name: Fogmoon Warden
Circle of the Moon.text: While in Wild Shape, you can turn into mist as a bonus action until the start of your next turn, gaining resistance to all damage and moving through creatures. Your Wild Shape attacks deal an extra 2d8 damage.

Circle of the Moon.name: Fiend-and-Seraph Shifter
Circle of the Moon.text: You can Wild Shape into celestials and fiends of CR 10 or lower that you have seen. While in such a form, your attacks deal an extra 3d8 radiant or fire damage, matching the form.

Circle of the Moon.name: Chaosform Shaper
Circle of the Moon.text: You can change Wild Shape forms as a bonus action without spending a use. When you do, you regain 3d8 hit points and your next attack before the end of your turn has advantage.

Circle of the Moon.name: Deepmoon Elder
Circle of the Moon.text: You can Wild Shape into aberrations and monstrosities of CR 15 or lower. While in such a form, your attacks deal an extra 4d8 damage and you gain blindsight to 60 feet.

Circle of the Moon.name: Moonheart Archdruid
Circle of the Moon.text: While in Wild Shape, you keep your own hit points as well as the form's, and dropping out of the form leaves you with your full total. Once per long rest you can return to Wild Shape automatically when it ends.

Circle of the Moon.name: Starbeast Sower
Circle of the Moon.text: You can Wild Shape into any creature of CR 20 or lower you have seen. While in such a form, your attacks deal an extra 5d8 damage, and you gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed.

Circle of the Moon.name: Hollow-Moon Hermit
Circle of the Moon.text: Once per long rest, Wild Shape into a void beast for 1 minute. You have resistance to all damage, your attacks deal an extra 8d8 force damage, and creatures you hit make a Constitution save or cannot regain hit points.

Circle of the Moon.name: Forgotten-Moon Seed
Circle of the Moon.text: Once per long rest, Wild Shape into a forgotten creature of CR 25 or lower of your design, approved by the DM, for 1 hour. Enemies make a Wisdom save or forget they have seen you each time you hit them.

Circle of the Moon.name: First-Beast Ancient
Circle of the Moon.text: Once per long rest, become the first beast for 1 minute: a Gargantuan form with 500 hit points, four attacks dealing 8d10 damage each, and immunity to charm, fear and paralysis.

Circle of the Sea.name: Fogtide Warden
Circle of the Sea.text: Your Wrath of the Sea now fills with sea fog. Creatures it damages make a Constitution save or are blinded until the start of their next turn. The emanation also deals an extra 2d8 cold damage.

Circle of the Sea.name: Brine-and-Brimstone Keeper
Circle of the Sea.text: When you cast a spell that deals cold or lightning damage, you can turn the water to boiling brine. The spell also deals 3d8 fire damage to each target. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

Circle of the Sea.name: Wildtide Shaper
Circle of the Sea.text: As an action, summon a wave in a 60-foot line, 20 feet wide. Creatures in it make a Strength save or take 6d8 bludgeoning damage, are pushed 20 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. Once per short rest.

Circle of the Sea.name: Drownroot Tideelder
Circle of the Sea.text: As an action, a creature within 120 feet makes a Strength save or is dragged into a trench of crushing water. It takes 8d8 cold damage and is restrained and drowning for 1 minute, repeating the save each turn. Once per long rest.

Circle of the Sea.name: Tideheart Archdruid
Circle of the Sea.text: You can breathe water and swim at twice your speed. Allies within 30 feet regain 2d8 hit points at the start of their turns while touching water. Once per long rest, flood a 60-foot radius with water for 1 hour.

Circle of the Sea.name: Horizon-Sea Sower
Circle of the Sea.text: Once per long rest, summon a starlit ocean in a 1-mile radius for 1 hour. You and allies can swim through it at flying speed, and enemies within it make a Strength save each turn or are pulled 30 feet in a direction you choose.

Circle of the Sea.name: Still-Water Hermit
Circle of the Sea.text: As an action, still all water and air in a 60-foot radius for 1 minute. Enemies there make a Constitution save or take 10d8 cold damage and cannot breathe. Half damage and breathing allowed on a success. Once per long rest.

Circle of the Sea.name: Forgotten-Tide Seed
Circle of the Sea.text: Once per long rest, raise a forgotten sea in a 300-foot radius for 1 minute. Enemies there make a Strength save each turn or take 8d10 cold damage and are restrained. Allies are unaffected and regain 4d10 hit points each turn.

Circle of the Sea.name: First-Sea Ancient
Circle of the Sea.text: Once per long rest, become the first ocean for 1 minute. You are immune to cold and lightning damage, and each turn you can drown a creature within 300 feet for 10d10 cold damage (Constitution save for half).

Circle of the Shepherd.name: Fogpath Shepherd
Circle of the Shepherd.text: Beasts and fey you summon appear wreathed in mist, invisible until they attack. Your Spirit Totem now also grants allies in its aura 2d8 temporary hit points when it is placed.

Circle of the Shepherd.name: Choir-and-Fang Keeper
Circle of the Shepherd.text: Creatures you summon can be celestial or fiendish variants. Celestial summons heal an ally within 30 feet for 2d8 hit points on each turn; fiendish summons deal an extra 2d8 fire damage on hits.

Circle of the Shepherd.name: Wildherd Shaper
Circle of the Shepherd.text: At the start of each of your turns, swap the positions of any two of your summons within 120 feet. Each summon also gains a random benefit on a d4: flight, extra attack, +1 AC, or 20 temporary hit points.

Circle of the Shepherd.name: Deepherd Elder
Circle of the Shepherd.text: You can summon abyssal beasts. As an action, summon one beast of CR 15 or lower that serves you for 1 hour. It has blindsight to 60 feet and deals an extra 3d8 cold damage on hits. Once per long rest.

Circle of the Shepherd.name: Heart-of-the-Herd Archdruid
Circle of the Shepherd.text: All your summons share your senses and act on your turn. Once per long rest, when a summon drops to 0 hit points, you can restore it to full hit points. Your Spirit Totem aura now has a 60-foot radius.

Circle of the Shepherd.name: Star-Herd Sower
Circle of the Shepherd.text: Once per long rest, call a beast from distant worlds of CR 20 or lower to serve you for 1 hour. It has resistance to all damage and deals an extra 4d8 radiant damage on hits.

Circle of the Shepherd.name: Lone-Shepherd Hermit
Circle of the Shepherd.text: Your summons cannot be detected by enemies until they attack and are immune to the charmed and frightened conditions. Once per long rest, all your summons gain an extra 6d8 force damage on their next hit.

Circle of the Shepherd.name: Forgotten-Herd Seed
Circle of the Shepherd.text: Once per long rest, call back the herd of extinct creatures for 1 hour. Summon up to ten beasts of CR 10 or lower that have vanished from the world. They obey you and cannot be targeted by enemy divination.

Circle of the Shepherd.name: First-Herd Ancient
Circle of the Shepherd.text: Once per long rest, summon the first beasts of the world for 1 hour: three primordial creatures of CR 25 or lower of your choice. They act on your turn and obey your commands.

Storm Caller.name: Mist-Thunder Warden
Storm Caller.text: When you deal lightning or thunder damage, the target is shrouded in fog and cannot see beyond 10 feet until the end of its next turn. Your storm spells deal an extra 2d8 damage. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

Storm Caller.name: Wrathcloud Keeper
Storm Caller.text: As an action, call a storm of fire and holy lightning in a 30-foot radius within 120 feet. Creatures make a Dexterity save, taking 4d8 fire and 4d8 lightning damage, or half on a success. Once per short rest.

Storm Caller.name: Wildstorm Shaper
Storm Caller.text: When you deal lightning damage, roll a d6. On 4 or higher, the lightning arcs to another creature within 30 feet, dealing half damage. On a 6, it arcs again. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

Storm Caller.name: Deepgale Elder
Storm Caller.text: As an action, drop the pressure in a 30-foot radius within 120 feet. Creatures make a Constitution save or take 6d8 thunder damage and are stunned until the end of their next turn. Half damage on a success. Once per long rest.

Storm Caller.name: Stormheart Archdruid
Storm Caller.text: You are immune to lightning and thunder damage and have a flying speed of 60 feet. When you deal lightning damage, you can heal an ally within 30 feet for half the damage dealt.

Storm Caller.name: Skyroad Stormseeder
Storm Caller.text: Once per long rest, create a storm over a 1-mile radius for 1 hour. Each round as a bonus action, call lightning on any creature in the storm, dealing 8d10 lightning damage (Dexterity save for half).

Storm Caller.name: Silent-Storm Hermit
Storm Caller.text: As an action, unleash a silent storm in a 60-foot radius. Creatures make a Constitution save or take 10d8 lightning damage and are deafened and silenced for 1 minute. Half damage on a success. Once per long rest.

Storm Caller.name: Forgotten-Storm Seed
Storm Caller.text: Once per long rest, call a forgotten storm for 1 minute. Your lightning ignores immunity and resistance, and once per turn you can strike every enemy within 120 feet for 6d10 lightning damage (Dexterity save for half).

Storm Caller.name: First-Storm Ancient
Storm Caller.text: Once per long rest, become the first tempest for 1 minute. You fly at 120 feet, are immune to all damage from weather, and each turn deal 10d10 lightning or thunder damage to up to three creatures (Dexterity save for half).

Wilderness Oracle.name: Mistsign Seer
Wilderness Oracle.text: When you finish a long rest, roll two d20s and record them. You can replace any attack roll, saving throw or ability check made by you or a creature you can see with one of these rolls, before the roll.

Wilderness Oracle.name: Augur of Two Thrones
Wilderness Oracle.text: As an action, read the signs around a creature within 60 feet. You learn its intentions and weaknesses, and attacks against it have advantage for 1 minute. It takes 3d8 psychic damage when first hit. Once per short rest.

Wilderness Oracle.name: Wildomen Shaper
Wilderness Oracle.text: Once per turn, after you or an ally within 30 feet makes a roll, you can roll a d6 and add or subtract it from the result. Uses equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

Wilderness Oracle.name: Deepsign Elder
Wilderness Oracle.text: You sense creatures within 120 feet that intend harm toward you or your allies. As a reaction when such a creature attacks, you can force it to reroll with disadvantage and take 5d8 psychic damage. Three times per long rest.

Wilderness Oracle.name: Heartsign Archdruid
Wilderness Oracle.text: You know the intended action of every creature within 60 feet before it acts. You cannot be surprised, and once per round, you can use your reaction to let an ally move 30 feet or make one attack before an enemy acts.

Wilderness Oracle.name: Horizon Oracle
Wilderness Oracle.text: Once per long rest, gaze into the future for 1 minute. You learn the outcome of a course of action up to 1 week ahead, and you gain three additional d20s for your Omens in the Fog feature.

Wilderness Oracle.name: Silent-Sign Hermit
Wilderness Oracle.text: Once per long rest, rewind time by 1 round. All creatures within 300 feet return to their positions and states at the start of the previous round. Only you and your allies remember what happened.

Wilderness Oracle.name: Forgotten-Sign Seed
Wilderness Oracle.text: Once per long rest, rewind time by 1 round. All creatures within 300 feet return to their positions and states at the start of the previous round, and only you and your allies remember what happened.

Wilderness Oracle.name: First-Sign Ancient
Wilderness Oracle.text: Once per long rest, see the first law of fate. For 1 minute, you choose the result of every die rolled by any creature within 300 feet, once per round per creature, before it is rolled.
